name: ag-abst
description: Antigua and Barbuda Sales Tax (ABST) for 2026. Covers the 17% standard rate set by the Revenue (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 2023, the tour operator change to the passenger transport exemption, the return due 15 calendar days after each tax period under the ABST (Amendment) Act 2024, the registration test and penalties in the IRD FAQ, how to take the tax out of an inclusive price, and the working papers for a return. Trigger phrases include ABST, Antigua sales tax, Antigua VAT, ABST return dead
author: openaccountants
